content: This information is not intended to serve as personalized medical advice and should not replace the guidance of your healthcare professional. Always consult your healthcare provider for comprehensive information about this product and your specific health needs. How to Use: Before starting this medication and each time you receive a refill, read the Patient Information Leaflet and Instructions for Use provided by your pharmacist, if available. Consult your healthcare provider for instructions on how to prepare and administer this medication. Inject the medication under the skin as directed by your doctor, typically in the abdomen. The dosage and duration of treatment depend on your medical condition, response to treatment, and any other medications you may be taking. Use the solution immediately after mixing. Before use, inspect the product for particles or discoloration; do not use the liquid if either is present. Clean the injection site with rubbing alcohol before each dose, and rotate injection sites to minimize skin injury. To reduce bruising, avoid rubbing the injection site after administration. Use this medication exactly as prescribed to achieve the best results. To help you remember, administer it at the same time each day. Side Effects: Common side effects may include headache, mild stomach pain or bloating, redness or pain at the injection site, breast tenderness, or dizziness. Remember, this medication has been prescribed because your doctor has determined that the benefits outweigh the risks of side effects. However, this medication may cause a condition called ovarian hyperstimulation syndrome (OHSS), which can occur during or after treatment. Rarely, severe OHSS can lead to sudden fluid buildup in the abdomen, chest, and heart area. Serious allergic reactions to this drug are rare. This is not a complete list of possible side effects. In the U.S., contact your doctor for medical advice about side effects. In Canada, consult your doctor for medical advice about side effects. Precautions: Before using this medication, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, to other products containing follicle-stimulating hormone or luteinizing hormone, or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other problems. This drug may cause dizziness, and alcohol or marijuana (cannabis) can exacerbate this effect. Avoid driving, operating machinery, or performing tasks requiring alertness until you can do so safely. Limit alcoholic beverages. This treatment may increase the likelihood of multiple births. Discontinue use if you become pregnant, as this medication must not be used during pregnancy. It is unknown if this drug passes into breast milk. Drug Interactions: Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase your risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. Overdose: If someone has overdosed and exhibits serious symptoms such as passing out or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. Monitoring: While using this medication, your doctor may order lab tests, such as blood hormone levels (e.g., estradiol) or vaginal ultrasounds, to monitor your progress. Attend all medical and lab appointments as scheduled. Lifestyle Changes: To enhance the effectiveness of this medication, consider lifestyle changes such as limiting alcohol consumption and quitting smoking. Missed Dose: It is crucial to use this medication on a fixed schedule as prescribed by your doctor. If you miss a dose, contact your doctor or pharmacist immediately for instructions. Storage: Store this medication in the refrigerator or at room temperature, away from light. Do not freeze. Avoid storing it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Important Notes: This summary does not contain all possible information about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
